purpose: Teach: エクアドル/リトル/リバー/ツイン/ニフティ/ポリス/サンデー/バックス

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でエクアドル習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you learned about Ecuador in social studies, right?
lines.style: Playful accusation, leaning in with a half-smile. Testing him with something specific she knows. Light, quick pace. The tone of someone who's caught someone else in a minor forgotten detail.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、リトルリーグでピッチャーだったな、桜
lines.en: You were a pitcher in Little League, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Shoots back with equal lightness, not defensive. Quick counter-volley. A knowing smile underneath. Pace matches hers—tit-for-tat rhythm, comfortable.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、リバーサイドでロケ撮ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were doing a shoot at Riverside, right?
lines.style: Escalates slightly—pushes deeper into his history. Still playful but with an edge of 'I know things about you.' Faster tempo. A little triumphant.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ツインルームで友達と泊まったな、桜
lines.en: You stayed in a twin room with a friend once, Sakura?
lines.style: Recovers smoothly. Returns serve without hesitation. Warm undertone—he's enjoying this. Steady, confident pace. Not rattled.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ニフティの言い回しよく使うな
lines.en: Riku, you use that Nifty phrasing all the time, don't you?
lines.style: Wry amusement tinges the accusation. Slower, more deliberate. Eyebrow raised in the voice. Affectionate mockery—she's noticed a quirk of his.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ザ・ポリスのEvery Breath歌ってたな、桜
lines.en: You used to sing 'Every Breath' by The Police, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Shifts to something more tender underneath the teasing. Slower delivery on the song title—protective almost, like he's admitting he noticed something vulnerable. Slight warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、サンデー漫画雑誌読んでたな
lines.en: Riku, you were reading manga magazines on Sundays, weren't you?
lines.style: Lightens again—surface playfulness returns. Quick, almost sing-song rhythm. Knows this detail is harmless and inconsequential. Grinning in her voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ラグビー部のバックスだったな、桜
lines.en: You played as a back on the rugby team, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Final volley. Lands with comfortable certainty. Close, intimate rhythm—they've done this dance before. Warm smile in the delivery. Unhurried.
